verdict: Dr. Ayaz proves that identity matrices aren't the only things stuck in a monochrome, predictable routine.
detailedQuote: The classic cream button-down tucked securely into high-waisted charcoal trousers signals a professor who calculates vector spaces faster than he picks out an outfit. It is the ultimate 'I have 800 midterms to grade and zero time for color theory' ensemble.
